sdkSessionToken.description: The provider SDK's own session material, handed to the Meld SDK to present the sheet with — for Banxa, a Primer client token. Deliberately NOT sessionToken: that field authenticates Meld's /crypto/session/* endpoints, which this cannot do and must never be attempted with. Populated for VENDOR_SDK; null otherwise.

presentation.description: How this order's Apple Pay surface is presented. The client dispatches on this and never on the service provider, so routing a new provider onto an existing shape needs no client change. Treat an unrecognised value as an unsupported order — the shapes are not interchangeable.

ApplePayOrder.description: Apple Pay response — present when paymentMethodType == APPLE_PAY. THREE shapes, and `presentation` is what to dispatch on — never the service provider, so a provider routed onto an existing shape needs no client change. The populated fields are disjoint per shape. NATIVE_TOKEN populates sessionToken + merchantTransactionId (the caller renders the Apple Pay sheet on its own surface, then drives the session-token endpoints: GET /crypto/session/applepay/paymentsession, POST /crypto/session/mercuryo/apple-pay/validate-merchant, POST /crypto/session/mercuryo/apple-pay/process, authenticated with sessionToken). PROVIDER_HOSTED populates paymentLinkUrl — a provider-hosted URL that opens the Apple Pay sheet directly when launched, with no intermediate screen. VENDOR_SDK populates sdkSessionToken + merchantIdentifier — the sheet belongs to the provider's own processor and is presented by the Meld SDK from that token; sessionToken is null and must not be substituted, since it cannot authenticate the session endpoints above.

BankTransferOrder.description: Bank-transfer response (ACH, FPS, SEPA, PIX, MOBILE_MONEY). There is no predefined field set. Call `GET /supported/payment-methods/requirements` without a serviceProvider to get requirements for every provider. Optionally filter by serviceProvider. Nested fields are nested objects.

serviceProviderWidgetUrl.description: Provider widget/session URL. For SDK-mounted providers (Uphold) this is the session's API-host URL handed to the provider's own web SDK (alongside sdkSessionToken); the SDK — not the caller — mounts the card iframe from it. Do not load this URL in an iframe yourself; that is unrelated to CardRenderMode.IFRAME, which describes the SDK's own render surface.

renderMode.description: Render mode for the card surface (NPP-sourced)

authorizeSessionUrl.description: Two-step (Option 1) providers only (e.g. Uphold): the URL the SDK POSTs the captured card id to (POST /crypto/order/{orderId}/authorize-session) to create the authorize widget session. Null for single-widget card providers.

continuationToken.description: Two-step (Option 1) providers only: short-lived bearer token the SDK passes on the authorize-session call. Null when not required.

sdkSessionToken.description: SDK-mounted providers (Uphold): the payment-session token. The Meld SDK feeds {serviceProviderWidgetUrl, sdkSessionToken, sdkSessionFlow} to the provider's web SDK (e.g. Uphold's PaymentWidget(session)), which mounts its own iframe and swaps to the widget host using this token. Null for URL-loadable providers.

sdkSessionFlow.description: SDK-mounted providers (Uphold): the session flow — 'select-for-deposit' for the capture widget, 'authorize' for the commit widget. Null for URL-loadable providers.

sdkSessionData.description: SDK-mounted providers: extra session `data` the provider's web SDK requires beyond the token — e.g. Uphold's authorize flow needs {"quoteId": ...}. The Meld SDK passes this as the widget session's `data`. Null when not required (e.g. the capture step).

verification.description: Verification attestation — required for COINBASEPAY + APPLE_PAY (Coinbase guest checkout), which needs agreementAcceptedAt. See HeadlessOrderVerification.

HeadlessOrderVerification.description: Verification attestation for providers that require verified contact details (COINBASEPAY APPLE_PAY). The verification ids are optional when the customer is verified through Meld; supply them only if you ran verification yourself against Coinbase's Onramp Verification API. agreementAcceptedAt is always required. Sandbox test values for self-minted ids: SMS destination with the +1000 prefix (e.g. +10005550100), email ending @sandbox.test, OTP code 000000.

agreementAcceptedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the customer accepted the service provider's guest-checkout terms. Required — Meld does not record terms acceptance. Must not be in the future and must be within the last 60 days. Accepted spellings: UTC (2026-07-28T12:00:00Z), extended offset (2026-07-28T12:00:00+00:00) and basic offset (2026-07-28T12:00:00+0000), each with optional fractional seconds and with seconds themselves optional (2026-07-28T12:00Z). Whichever you send, Meld forwards a single canonical UTC form to the provider.

externalSubaccountCustomerId.description: Optional external identifier for the sub-account customer this transaction belongs to. Used for tracking when multiple businesses operate under one Meld account. A sub-account customer must be created first before it can be referenced.

fiatAmountInUsd.description: The fiat amount of the transaction in usd

isImported.description: Return ***True*** if this transaction was initiated outside Meld

isPassthrough.description: Return ***True*** if the passthrough credentials were used

key.description: Pagination key, may be used with the "after" parameter in search requests.  Only set and relevant for paginated calls

multiFactorAuthorizationStatus.description: The transaction required multi-factor authentication methods, and their current status. When required, must be approved for the purchase tobe completed successfully.

orderId.description: Unique identifier for the order associated with this transaction, when applicable

parentPaymentTransactionId.description: The Id of the associated object for this line item

passthroughReference.description: The unique reference you use to identify the partner on whose behalf you created this transaction.  This might be a String or UUID in your system to identify a merchant or partner.  This is needed so that you can associate passthrough transactions to your partners who may not be registered with Meld

paymentMethodType.description: Payment Method type used for this transaction.

serviceProvider.description: The service provider used for this transaction

serviceProviderCreatedAt.description: The ISO 8601 DateTime when the transaction was created on the service provider's side

serviceProviderTransactionUrl.description: A link to the resource on the Service Provider, may not be present

serviceTransactionId.description: The service provider's unique identifier for this transaction

sourceAmount.description: The amount of the transaction

sourceCurrencyCode.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Must be a supported currency

status.description: The current status of the transaction

subaccountCustomerId.description: Optional Meld customer id used to track the business sub-account this transaction belongs to when multiple businesses operate under one Meld account.

updatedAt.description: Time at which the object was last updated. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

destinationAmount.description: Destination currency amount to be received for this quote

destinationAmountWithoutFees.description: The fiat amount exchanged when selling crypto, excluding fees. This will be deprecated in the future.

destinationCurrencyCode.description: Code of currency being quoted: BTC, ETH, ...

exchangeRate.description: The exchange rate at the time the request is sent

fiatAmountWithoutFees.description: The fiat amount exchanged when buying or selling crypto, excluding fees.

isNativeAvailable.description: Indicates if native Apple Pay flow is available for this quote

networkFee.description: The network fee applied to a crypto transaction. To ensure that transactions are processed on cryptocurrency networks, outgoing transactions to external cryptocurrency addresses typically incur a "mining" or "network" fee. This fee is paid to cryptocurrency miners, which are the systems that process the transactions and secure the respective network.

partnerFee.description: The fee amount charged by the partner to process your customer's purchase.

paymentMethodType.description: Payment Method Type used for this quote

rampIntelligence.description: A collection of information on how to rank the quotes returned to you, based on Meld's scoring algorithms. Read more about this [here](https://docs.meld.io/docs/ramp-intelligence).

serviceProvider.description: Service Provider used on this quote

sourceAmount.description: Amount requested + fees

sourceAmountWithoutFees.description: The fiat amount being used to buy crypto, excluding fees. This will be deprecated in the future.

sourceCurrencyCode.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Must be a supported currency

totalFee.description: The total amount of fees that will be charged.

transactionFee.description: The fee amount charged by the service provider to process your customer's purchase

transactionType.description: The type of crypto transaction, which is CRYPTO_PURCHASE or CRYPTO_SELL.

RampIntelligence.description: Ramp intelligence: ramp score and low KYC indicator for the quote

lowKyc.description: LowKYC indicates if the quote amount is below the provider's low KYC threshold, meaning the user may not need to upload documents, which can increase conversion. Read more about this feature [here](https://docs.meld.io/docs/conversion-routing).

previouslyUsed.description: Timestamp of previously successful purchase for this customer on this ramp

rampScore.description: A numerical score representing the expectation a Customer will convert (Ramp score). Read more about this feature [here](https://docs.meld.io/docs/conversion-routing).
